meta_description:
323K likes, 1,303 comments - vogueindia on October 28, 2026: "“I would love for there to be a few more poetic, wistful adjectives alongside ‘hard-working’,” Katrina Kaif (@katrinakaif) tells Vogue India. Having watched Sridevi, Rekha and Madhuri Dixit make poetry out of movement when she first entered the industry, she believes dancing should bring the performer genuine joy, however much work goes into it. And if the average party playlist is anything to go by, the audience has been having a pretty good time too.

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.
